# glinet_wireguard_server (Resource)

Manage one stock GL.iNet WireGuard server. Client configuration and key distribution remain in the stock UI.

<!-- schema generated by tfplugindocs -->
## Schema

### Required

- `name` (String) Server section name, normally `main_server`.

### Optional

- `access` (String) Default access policy: ACCEPT, REJECT, or DROP.
- `address_v4` (String) IPv4 server address and prefix.
- `address_v6` (String) IPv6 server address and prefix.
- `client_to_client` (Boolean) Allow clients to reach each other.
- `delete_behavior` (String) Destroy behavior. `forget` releases Terraform ownership and preserves the UCI section; `delete` removes a Terraform-created named section. Firmware-owned anonymous sections are always preserved.
- `masq` (Boolean) Enable masquerading for server traffic.
- `port` (Number) UDP listen port.

### Read-Only

- `id` (String) Stable import identifier.
- `uci_section` (String) Resolved UCI section name on the router.
